description: This file defines the OrderService class that handles order-related operations such as fetching, placing, and canceling orders using an API client.

classes.name: OrderService
classes.description: Service class for handling order operations including fetching, creating, and canceling orders.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Fetches the current user's list of orders.

methods.name: getOrderById
methods.description: Retrieves a specific order by its ID.

methods.name: placeOrder
methods.description: Places a new order with specified delivery address and optional notes.

methods.name: cancelOrder
methods.description: Cancels an existing order by its ID.
